prompt: Call the 6-and-under tee-ball season opener like a WWE main event, commentary table and all.
response:
**(The scene opens not on a broadcast booth, but at a flimsy folding table set up in the grass beyond the right-field foul line. The table is adorned with a neon "SLAMMIN’ SAMMY’S T-BALL" banner and three oversized foam fingers. Behind it sit three commentators wearing headsets over sun hats.)**

**MICHAEL COLE (Play-by-Play):** LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, WELCOME TO WHAT IS UNDOUBTEDLY THE MOST ANTICIPATED SPECTACLE IN SPORTS ENTERTAINMENT! We are LIVE from the Oak Creek Community Park for the 6-AND-UNDER T-BALL SEASON OPENER! I’m Michael Cole, alongside WWE Hall of Famer "Macho Man" Randy Savage, and the toughest woman in sports, Chyna! The energy here is ELECTRIC! The juice boxes are CHILLED! And the grass stains are IMMINENT!

**RANDY SAVAGE:** *(Screaming into the mic, veins bulging)* OH YEAH! DIG IT, BROTHER! The sun is shining, the velcro shoes are STRAPPED TIGHT, and little Timmy Henderson is staring down that orange rubber tee like it owes him MONEY! This isn’t just baseball, Cole! This is a TEST OF WILL! A BATTLE OF ATTENTION SPANS! Can he focus? CAN HE FIND THE BALL?! THE CROWD IS ON THEIR FEET—WELL, THEY’RE SITTING ON BLANKETS, BUT THEIR SPIRITS ARE SOARING, OH YEAH!

**CHYNA:** I’ve been in the ring with monsters, Cole, but nothing is more unpredictable than a kindergartner who just consumed a fruit snack. Look at the stance on Henderson. Feet shoulder-width apart. Helmet slightly crooked. He’s got that thousand-yard stare. He doesn’t know if he’s batting or if he’s supposed to be chasing a butterfly. THAT’S THE DANGER. THAT’S THE X-FACTOR.

**COLE:** And here comes the pitch—or rather, THE PLACEMENT! Coach Dave, a man who has dedicated countless Tuesday evenings to this moment, bends at the waist! He places the ball! THE BALL IS ON THE TEE! THE CROWD ERUPTS!

**SAVAGE:** THE TENSION IS PALPABLE, BROTHER! Timmy’s grip is HIGH ON THE BAT! Too high? Maybe! But he’s got HEART! He’s got the spirit of a CHAMPION flowing through those light-up sneakers!

**COLE:** Coach Dave gives the signal! It’s a nod! A subtle, encouraging nod! TIMMY SWINGS!

*(A loud plastic THWACK echoes across the park)*

**CHYNA:** CONTACT! SOLID CONTACT! THE BAT CONNECTED WITH THE SPHERE!

**SAVAGE:** HE LAUNCHED IT! GOODNESS GRACIOUS, MISS SUSIE! IT’S A GROUNDER! A SCORCHING, UNSTOPPABLE, TWO-MILES-PER-HOUR GROUNDER PAST THE PITCHER’S MOUND! THE PITCHER, LITTLE SOPHIA, IS CURRENTLY EXAMINING A DANDELION! SHE NEVER SAW IT COMING! IT’S A BLINDSIDE ATTACK!

**COLE:** TIMMY IS RUNNING! HE’S RACING TO FIRST BASE! BUT WAIT! HE’S STOPPED! HE’S STOPPED HALFWAY TO ADMIRE THE FLIGHT OF A BEE! THIS IS UNBELIEVABLE! THE DRAMA! THE UNCERTAINTY!

**CHYNA:** This is rookie mistake, Cole! You can’t admire the bee! The bee is not your tag partner! FIRST BASE COACH BARBARA IS WAVING HER ARMS FRANTICALLY! SHE’S CUTTING OFF THE RUNNER! SHE’S THE ENFORCER IN THIS SCENARIO!

**SAVAGE:** BARBARA IS SCREAMING "RUN, TIMMY, RUN!" WITH THE FEROCITY OF A MANAGER IN A CAGE MATCH! TIMMY HEARS THE CALL! THE BEE IS FORGOTTEN! HE DIGS DEEP! HE FINDS THAT EXTRA GEAR! HE’S STUMBLING! HE’S TRIPPING OVER HIS OWN UNTIED SHOE-LACE BUT HE IS STILL MOVING FORWARD! OH, THE HUMANITY!

**COLE:** HE’S APPROACHING FIRST BASE! THE THROW FROM THE SECOND BASEMAN—WHO WAS JUST SITTING IN THE DIRT—IS ERRATIC! IT’S WIDE! IT’S INTO THE OUTFIELD GRASS! TIMMY STOMPS ON THE BAG! THE UMPIRE, A VOLUNTEER DAD NAMED GREG, RAISES HIS ARM!

**ALL THREE:** HE’S SAFE! HE’S SAFE! HE’S SAFE!

**COLE:** UNBELIEVABLE SCENES HERE AT OAK CREEK! Timmy Henderson has reached base safely in the season opener! The parents are CHEERING! The siblings are INDIFFERENT! Coach Dave is offering a HIGH-FIVE that Timmy has completely MISSED!

**SAVAGE:** THAT’S THE BEAUTY OF T-BALL, BROTHER! NO STRIKEOUTS! NO TEARS! JUST PURE, UNFILTERED CHAOS AND ORANGE SLICES! TIMMY HENDERSON MAY NOT KNOW WHAT AN INNING IS, BUT HE KNOWS HE SURVIVED! AND IN THIS BUSINESS, SURVIVAL IS VICTORY! OH YEAH!

**CHYNA:** Don’t get comfortable, though. Up next is Liam Chen, and I saw him eyeing the snack table
